summary.content:
Today's selection covers 93 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 61 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic Researchers Raise Alarm Over A.I. Acceleration, Warning of Threat to Humanity
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Veradigm warns of patient data breach after ransomware gang claims attack
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, The Verge, TechCrunch, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 62 articles published in the last 24 hours
